## Прио-Внешторгбанк — Company.id 4399

Catalog metadata (unchanged):

```json
{
  "countryCode": "RU",
  "fullTitle": null,
  "id": 4399,
  "title": "\u041f\u0440\u0438\u043e-\u0412\u043d\u0435\u0448\u0442\u043e\u0440\u0433\u0431\u0430\u043d\u043a",
  "url": "priovtb.ru"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-02T12:15:28.567859Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- No existing icon.svg at frozen base commit; this is the first icon addition.
- Fetched source SVG: [source.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/0cf3afa9fad805da4103afe7a6ef9ab8190dab19/review-materials/4399/source.svg) — SHA-256 `9db693cd28da74a519fa455318fef470b127e0d67909549105f78d19103a581f`.

- Generated VectorDrawable XML: [final.xml](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/0cf3afa9fad805da4103afe7a6ef9ab8190dab19/review-materials/4399/final.xml) — SHA-256 `65cdd58800f4c0b5c0d851eaa673fac15efa008cd34b9056deff0367387893a3`.
- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/0cf3afa9fad805da4103afe7a6ef9ab8190dab19/review-materials/4399/candidate.diff).
- Source page: [https://priovtb.com/](https://priovtb.com/).
- Source asset: [https://priovtb.com/local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo-xs.svg](https://priovtb.com/local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo-xs.svg).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-02T12:01:52Z: [https://priovtb.com/](https://priovtb.com/); asset [https://priovtb.com/local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo-xs.svg](https://priovtb.com/local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo-xs.svg). Direct fetch of the compact mark SVG: 1629 bytes, 28x28 viewBox, vector paths, fills #d9007e and #00b295, no embedded raster. Receipt \[local artifact not published; reference omitted\]. (independence group: official-site).
- official checked 2026-10-02T12:01:52Z: [https://priovtb.com/](https://priovtb.com/); asset [https://priovtb.com/local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo.svg](https://priovtb.com/local/templates/project/dist/images/icons/logo.svg). Full horizontal lockup SVG \(141x36, mark + ПРИО ВНЕШТОРГБАНК wordmark as vector paths\) referenced and used site-wide; confirms the mark in logo-xs.svg is the bank emblem. Rejected as the catalog asset because it carries separate lettering. (independence group: official-site).
- official checked 2026-10-02T12:00:00Z: [https://www.cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1026200000111](https://www.cbr.ru/finorg/foinfo/?ogrn=1026200000111). CBR financial-organization record for OGRN 1026200000111 \(Прио-Внешторгбанк\): license #212, operating license dated 2016-01-29, no revocation entry; supports currency of the current brand presentation. (independence group: cbr-registry).
- Independent evidence: The official site is the primary source for the asset; the CBR registry independently confirms the legal entity, license number and operating status. These are different publications, not mirrors..
- Identity: confirmed — Fetched homepage identifies the site as Прио-Внешторгбанк and the record title is Прио-Внешторгбанк \(RU\). The mark in logo-xs.svg is the same emblem used in the site-wide logo lockup \(four rounded corner brackets around a ring-and-disc emblem\), so the asset belongs to this bank record..

- Variant: confirmed — logo-xs.svg \(28x28 viewBox 0 0 28 28\) is the compact mark-only variant that the official site itself uses site-wide; it contains no separate lettering. Verified fills in the fetched bytes: #d9007e and #00b295 \(researcher note claiming teal-only was wrong; source inspected directly\). Full horizontal lockup logo.svg \(141x36\) includes the wordmark and is unsuitable for a square cell; the mark-only variant is the official standalone form..

Rationale: First addition: the record has no icon.svg. The official compact mark variant of Прио-Внешторгбанк is an original two-color vector served by the bank's own live site; it is a standalone emblem without accompanying lettering and is therefore suitable for the catalog square cell..
Role: Standalone bank mark \(the emblem-only compact variant of the official logo lockup\); the magenta rounded-square contour is the branded silhouette, not an empty canvas.; variant: Official compact icon-only variant \(logo-xs.svg\) of the current brand mark, used site-wide on priovtb.com; distinct from the 141x36 lockup which carries the wordmark..
Visible difference: First addition: there is no base icon; the diff is absent-to-real-icon. No pre-existing design is modified or replaced..
Details: All source contours survive: the magenta rounded-square silhouette with its four notched corner cutouts, the transparent ring between square and disc \(verified showing the dark background through on the dark-theme pair, i.e. true internal alpha, not white fill\), and the teal disc. Proportions: Square 28x28 emblem fills the cell with the geometry the official site itself uses for its compact icon; no scaling, translation or backing transform was applied, so proportions are the source's own. The mark stays recognizable at 24/32/48 px diagnostics on both themes because it reduces to three high-contrast simple shapes..

Source-to-final transformations:
- None: final.svg is the original fetched vector after source-preserving optimization with SVGO 4.1.0 using the repository's committed SVGO configuration \(multipass, floatPrecision 4\); file size went from 1629 to 1051 bytes \(-35.5%\). The optimized version was selected after a raster comparison against the working copy showed no visible change \(only 27 sub-pixel antialias pixels of 50176 in a 224 px preview\). No backing change and no geometry transform were applied; internal transparency is preserved.

### Light and dark first icon addition

![First icon addition — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/0cf3afa9fad805da4103afe7a6ef9ab8190dab19/review-materials/4399/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![First icon addition — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/0cf3afa9fad805da4103afe7a6ef9ab8190dab19/review-materials/4399/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-02T12:14:36.784763299Z`. Source/final: Full original source \(fetched logo-xs.svg bytes, librsvg source reference raster\) versus final.svg on both themes: identical geometry, colors and internal transparency; the optimized bytes differ from the source only by SVGO reserialization verified pixel-near-identical \(27 antialias pixels in a 224px preview\). No invented colors or shapes.; base/final and rendering: First addition: baseline absent \(iconHash null, confirmed pinned-path absence\), no base/final pair exists and none was fabricated. Final-only frames on light and dark backgrounds \(offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource, 240px canvas\) were inspected: the emblem is complete, high-contrast and legible on both themes; the transparent ring correctly shows the theme background.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — Android SDK is installed \(build-tools 36.0.0, platform android-37.0\) but no emulator binary and no system images are present, so a headless AVD cannot be created without downloads, which are outside this run. Risk: the Compose Android rendering path was not directly observed..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — The same missing emulator and system-image prerequisite applies; no Android device runtime is available. Risk: native Android view rendering was not observed..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — This is a Linux host without an iOS SDK, toolchain or simulator. Risk: the iOS Compose rendering path was not observed..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — This is a Linux host without an iOS SDK, toolchain or simulator. Risk: native iOS rendering was not observed..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
